description: Create the core application files for contrafactum-ai: prompts.py, generator.py, validator.py, repair.py, app.py, requirements.txt, and updated README.md. This is the full MVP implementation.
steps: Create requirements.txt at /projects/sandbox/pyesia/requirements.txt with: streamlit, openai, anthropic, python-dotenv (for env var loading). Also include numpy and matplotlib which are already dependencies of pyesia.

Create prompts.py at /projects/sandbox/pyesia/prompts.py with master prompts. Include: SYSTEM_PROMPT (defines the AI as a Mexican Spanish lyricist that writes contrafactums), GENERATION_PROMPT (template that receives: original lyrics structure as JSON template with section names, line counts, syllable counts per line, rhyme pattern, rhyme endings; new theme; style; instructs the AI to produce lyrics matching the template exactly), REPAIR_PROMPT (template that receives: the failing lines with their expected metrics and what went wrong, instructs AI to rewrite only those lines while preserving rhyme scheme and meaning). Prompts must emphasize: natural Mexican Spanish, zero literal copying of phrases from original, maintain syllable count within +/-1, maintain rhyme pattern.

Create generator.py at /projects/sandbox/pyesia/generator.py. It should: (a) import os for env vars, (b) support both OpenAI and Anthropic via CONTRAFACTUM_PROVIDER env var (default 'openai'), (c) use OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env vars, (d) have a function extract_template(lyrics_text: str) -> dict that uses pyesia functions to analyze the input lyrics - split by blank lines into sections, for each section analyze each line's metric syllables using the logic from perform_analysis but adapted to work on strings (split verse into words, count syllables with synalephas, apply verse_type correction), detect rhyme scheme using rhyme_scheme(), and return a JSON-serializable template dict with structure: {sections: [{name: 'Seccion 1', lines: [{text: original_line, metric_syllables: int, rhyme_group: str or null}], rhyme_endings: {group: ending_sound}}]}, (e) have a function generate_contrafactum(template: dict, theme: str, style: str) -> str that builds the prompt from prompts.py templates, calls the LLM API, and returns the generated lyrics as a string. Use temperature 0.8 for creativity.

Create validator.py at /projects/sandbox/pyesia/validator.py. It should: (a) import from pyesia.spanish_poetry_functions the needed functions, (b) have function validate_lyrics(generated_text: str, template: dict) -> dict that: splits generated text into sections (by blank lines), checks section count matches template, checks line count per section matches, for each line computes metric syllables and compares to template (pass if within +/-1), checks rhyme pattern matches (using rhyme() function on line-final words that should rhyme according to template), (c) return a validation report dict: {valid: bool, section_count: {expected, got, pass}, lines: [{section, line_num, text, expected_syllables, actual_syllables, syllable_pass, expected_rhyme_group, rhyme_pass}], summary: {total_lines, passed_lines, failed_lines}}.

Create repair.py at /projects/sandbox/pyesia/repair.py. It should: (a) have function repair_lyrics(generated_text: str, template: dict, validation_report: dict) -> str that: identifies failed lines from the validation report, builds a repair prompt using REPAIR_PROMPT from prompts.py with context about what each failing line needs (target syllables, rhyme group, surrounding lines for context), calls the LLM to get replacement lines, substitutes only the failed lines in the original generated text, returns the repaired full text. (b) have a MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS = 3 constant to prevent infinite loops.

Create app.py at /projects/sandbox/pyesia/app.py with Streamlit interface. Layout: (a) Title 'Contrafactum AI' with brief description, (b) Left column/sidebar: text_area for pasting base lyrics (placeholder with example corrido snippet), text_input for new theme, selectbox for style (options: 'Corrido mexicano', 'Norteno clasico', 'Banda', 'Espiritual', 'Bolero', 'Cumbia', 'Ranchera', 'Personalizado'), if 'Personalizado' show another text_input, (c) 'Generar Contrafactum' button, (d) On click: show spinner while processing, call extract_template, display template JSON in expander, call generate_contrafactum, call validate_lyrics, if validation has failures and repair attempts remain call repair_lyrics then re-validate (up to 3 times), (e) Display results: generated lyrics in a text block, metric report as a table (line number, expected syllables, actual syllables, pass/fail), rhyme report, list of any remaining failed lines highlighted, the detected template JSON in an expander at the bottom.

Update README.md at /projects/sandbox/pyesia/README.md. Keep existing content, add a new section '# Contrafactum AI' with: description of what the app does, installation instructions (pip install -r requirements.txt, pip install -e ., set OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and optionally CONTRAFACTUM_PROVIDER env var), usage instructions (streamlit run app.py), brief explanation of the contrafactum workflow.
Install dependencies and verify all imports work: run pip install -e . && pip install -r requirements.txt, then verify with python -c imports.
